verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents an interactive Request Builder that generates API requests in the language of your choice. It also has an API reference section with streaming and schema-overview pages, and a probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, which could feed interactive tooling. None of the evidence shows that the reference pages let you run examples in the browser, so 'runnable' is only implied by generated request code. missing for 10: evidence of in-page runnable/try-it API calls, explicit interactive per-endpoint reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
